detailZones.title: Cabin connection and entry
detailZones.translation: 客舱连接与卫生间入口
detailZones.description: Trace the open entrance, cabin-side curtain, jamb, grab hardware and threshold details.

detailZones.title: Upper wall and service fittings
detailZones.description: Study the visible ceiling, mirror cabinet, shelf, upper panels, vents and light fittings.

detailZones.title: Vanity and wash basin
detailZones.description: Inspect the visible wash basin, faucet, soap dispenser, towel fitting, counter and cabinet face.

detailZones.title: Toilet fixture and lower compartment
detailZones.description: Trace the visible toilet fixture, flush hardware, shroud, sidewall panels and floor mount details.

detailZones.title: Right door and wall hardware
detailZones.description: Study the visible lavatory door, latch, grab rails, coat hook, access panels and trim.

detailZones.title: Lower floor and cabinet base
detailZones.description: Follow the visible lavatory floor pan, edge trim, vanity base, curtain hem and threshold joints.

anchorAudit.rationale: The final 1600 by 900 aircraft-lavatory photograph was inspected at source and output resolution. It retains 138 independently pointable entrance, upper-service, vanity, toilet, door-hardware and floor parts. Passenger actions, cleanliness claims, safety outcomes, airline identity, readable signs and hidden plumbing or electrical systems were excluded.
